journey.name: Styling and Typography Journey
journey.description: Verify customizable typography with serif/monospace font families, custom title and description font colors, and reload button visibility toggle

actions.action: Select font family "Serif" from the typography spinner
Verify font family selection reflects in the widget preview
Open title font color picker and select a custom color (e.g., Red or Blue)
Verify title color indicator updates to selected color
Open description font color picker and select a custom color (e.g., Green or Amber)
Verify description color indicator updates to selected color
Verify the "Show reload button" toggle is enabled by default
Toggle off the "Show reload button" switch
Verify the widget header reload button is hidden
Verify feed articles display with the chosen serif font family and custom title/description colors
